color-system.twistDescription: Verbatim copy — no twist applied. pageBackground #fff7e9 (luminance ~248, confirmed light register).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 — added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em. Font substitutions: Canva Sans → Plus Jakarta Sans, Times → Lora, Noto Sans Variable/Vietnamese → Noto Sans. All woff2 replaced with Google Fonts CDN imports.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Easing curve swap — all 'ease' → 'ease-in-out', all 'cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1)' → 'cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)' (Material standard). Applied consistently across all transitionElements.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Gap value scaling ×1.4 — bp-760px: 10px → 14px, bp-768px: 14px → 20px, bp-992px: 8px → 11px, bp-1024px columnGap: 40px → 56px, rowGap: 16px → 22px.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Button padding shift +12px horizontal — elements.button and elements.cta paddingRight/Left: 37.5px → 49.5px.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Languid hover transition speed +0.15s — buttons: 0.3s → 0.45s ease-in-out, button link transform: 0.3s → 0.45s ease-out, nav/links: 0.2s → 0.35s ease-in-out, link-2: 0.1s → 0.25s linear.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Item spacing change +10px — geometry.itemSpacing: 13.875 → 23.875. Center-logo layout preserved.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Kinetic shift applied to Section 5 ('Background and Section Design Behavior') — reframed static tonal pacing as directed thermal motion, a cooling sequence rather than atmospheric continuity. concept_by_video.md generated fresh.
